Catch and Run Size

This indicator provides information on the catch in US and Canadian fisheries and the run size each year for the selected Conservation Unit(s). Run size is the total abundance of salmon that survive to maturity and is calculated as catch plus the estimated number of adult salmon that reach the spawning grounds.
